goal: Build the new Dashboard overview page and Analytics charts page

Built AdminDashboard.jsx (188 lines) with 5 summary KPI cards — Unread Messages, Messages Today, Pending Quotations, Total Farmers, Total Revenue — populated from /admin/stats and /chat/all endpoints.
